components.css: .ds-site{display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-width:340px;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#16181D);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.05);transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}.ds-site:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}.ds-site:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent-ink,#B8431F);outline-offset:2px}.ds-site-band{background:var(--acc);color:#fff;padding:16px 18px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:84px}.ds-site-logo{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.25);flex:none}.ds-site-dom{font-family:var(--head,'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif);font-weight:600;font-size:19px;line-height:1.1}.ds-site-dom small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:12px;opacity:.9;margin-top:3px}.ds-site-body{padding:14px 18px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}.ds-site-body p{margin:0;font-size:15px}.ds-site-body ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:14px}.ds-site-body li{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#E4E2DC)}.ds-site-body li:last-child{border-bottom:0}.ds-site-body li::before{content:'';flex:none;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);margin-top:8px}.ds-site-go{font-family:var(--head,'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;color:var(--accent-ink,#B8431F)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-site{transition:none}.ds-site:hover{transform:none}}

narrative.overview:
Every site Richard runs is a key on one ring, and this page is the ring. Each site card is a key you grab and go: it carries its own club or artist colour in a solid band at the top, while everything around it (the ink masthead, the paper ground, the white cards) stays the same for every site. The RMC three-key logo and the keycap buttons, which press down when you click them, are the signature details. The page should feel plain, warm and tactile: like a well-worn set of keys, not a pitch deck.

The page is quiet so the sites' colours can be loud. Neutrals are slightly warm (paper, not grey), there is one brand accent, and type is set in sentence case with Space Grotesk for anything that labels or announces and the system font for reading. Layout is a single centred column of white cards on paper. It's dense enough to scan on a phone around match day, with 44px tap targets throughout. Depth is minimal: surfaces sit flat, lift slightly when you hover, and the keycaps press.
keyCharacteristics: Ink masthead band across the full width; paper ground; white cards with 18px corners.
Per-site colour bands carry each site's identity; the frame around them never changes.
One brand accent, signal orange, kept to the logo's C key and large marks.
Keycap buttons with a solid base that presses down.
Light and dark themes defined entirely through tokens.

rules.name: The One Orange Key Rule
rules.body: Only the C key is ever orange. Signal orange appears on the logo and large marks; small text and links use accent ink instead.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour goes through a token in the `:root` block of `site.css` and is redefined for dark mode. No colour value is written straight into a rule unless it is a translucent overlay on an already-tokened surface.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colours Rule
rules.body: A site's colour lives only inside that site's card. It never tints the masthead, the page ground or another card.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading, label, button and nav item is in sentence case. No all-caps eyebrows, no letter-spaced shouting.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk labels and announces; the system font explains. Don't set paragraphs in Space Grotesk or headings in the system font.

rules.name: The Flat Until Touched Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth appears only when you hover or press: the lift and the keycap press. Never add resting shadows to cards.

rules.name: The Many-Links Card Stays Put Rule
rules.body: A card that holds several links (an `article`, not one big link) does not lift on hover, because lifting suggests the whole card is a single target.

dos: Do put every new colour in the `:root` block of `site.css` and redefine it under both dark-mode selectors.
Do give each new site its own site-colour token and set it on its card as the card accent.
Do keep tap targets at least 44px tall, including link-list rows and buttons.
Do use accent ink, not signal orange, for any accent text or link.
Do use the C key alone (no lockup) when the mark is 32px or smaller.
Do check light and dark at 1280 and 390 wide with no horizontal overflow.
Do bump the `?v=` stamp on the `site.css` link in every HTML file when the stylesheet changes.
donts: Don't make anything but the C key orange.
Don't add resting shadows to cards; depth is for hover and press only.
Don't let a site's colour leak outside its own card.
Don't use uppercase or letter-spaced labels; everything is sentence case.
Don't make cards that hold several links lift on hover.
Don't set paragraphs in Space Grotesk.
